# Sync the docs with the code

The code is the truth for what exists; the spec is the truth for what is intended. When they differ, report it; fix the doc when the code is right, and tell the user when the code looks wrong.

## What to compare

| Doc says | Check against |
| --- | --- |
| Routes and paths (spec section 2, 6.3, README) | `routes` in `src/router/index.ts`, guards in `src/router/guards.ts` |
| Screen rules and their order (spec section 2.1) | `resolveGameScreen` in `src/domain/game-screen.ts` and its test |
| API calls table (spec section 5) | the functions in `src/api/services/*.ts`: method, path, header, body. Every service function has a row and every row has a function |
| Socket events (spec section 7) | `SOCKET_EVENTS` in `src/api/socket-events.ts`, and the handlers passed to `useGameSocket` in `src/views/` |
| Languages and storage key (spec section 6.1, CLAUDE.md, README) | `LOCALES`, `LOCALE_NAMES`, `LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY` in `src/i18n/locales.ts` and the files in `src/i18n/messages/` |
| Labels tables (spec section 6.2) | `labels` in `src/i18n/messages/en.ts` and the unions in `src/api/types/enums.ts` |
| Scripts (README "Scripts", CLAUDE.md "Commands", AGENTS.md) | `scripts` in `package.json` |
| Coverage thresholds (spec section 9, README, CLAUDE.md) | `test.coverage.thresholds` in `vite.config.ts` |
| Node version | `engines` in `package.json` and `.nvmrc` |
| Environment variables (README "Configuration") | `.env.example` and `src/config/env.ts` |
| Project structure (README, CLAUDE.md "Structure") | the folders of `src/` and `tests/` as they are on disk |
| PWA (spec section 4, "Install rules", README) | `public/manifest.webmanifest`, `public/sw.js`, `src/services/pwa.ts` |
| Skills and agents named in docs | the files in `.agents/skills/` and `.agents/agents/` |

## Steps

1. Read each doc in full, then each code location in the table. Do not infer from names; open the files.
2. List every mismatch: doc location, what it says, what the code has. Include missing items (a route, script or key with no doc) and stale items (documented but gone).
3. Fix the docs. Keep their voice: short sentences, English, no emojis. Do not change the look described in spec section 4 without the user's decision (see `CLAUDE.md`, Styling).
4. `CLAUDE.md` is the full source of the project rules; `AGENTS.md` and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` summarise it. If you change a rule, change it in `CLAUDE.md` first, then in the two summaries.
5. Run `npm run check:agents` if you touched anything in `.agents/`, and `npm test` (the tooling test also checks that `npm run <script>` mentions in skills, agents and instruction files exist).
6. Report: the mismatches found, what you changed, and what you left for the user (for example a code behaviour that disagrees with the spec).
